name: Set-Theoretic Reduction
description: Transforms the definition of a 3-clique from a structural graph property into an equivalent algebraic/set-theoretic condition ($S \subseteq (E_a \cap E_b) \cup (E_b \cap E_c) \cup (E_c \cap E_a)$). This defeats pattern-matching models because they will likely implement the set operations literally (resulting in an O(N^3) TLE) unless they genuinely reason through the set equations to deduce that the condition simply means a, b, and c are mutually adjacent.
